title: Center Manager
description:
Centre Manager – Job Summary

The Centre Manager is responsible for overseeing overall center operations, administration, patient care, business development, compliance, staff management, and financial performance. The role includes managing daily operations, floor management, patient satisfaction, documentation, inventory, vendor coordination, hygiene standards, audits, and regulatory compliance. The Centre Manager ensures smooth coordination among doctors, nurses, embryologists, and other healthcare professionals while maintaining NABH/NABL/ISO standards. Responsibilities also include achieving revenue and booking targets, handling reporting, managing budgets, conducting staff training, monitoring KPIs, supporting marketing activities, and ensuring effective patient counselling and relationship management. The role requires strong leadership, operational excellence, multitasking ability, and expertise in healthcare management. Candidates should preferably possess a medical degree with a Master’s in Healthcare Administration and 5–6 years of relevant healthcare management experience, preferably in fertility or hospital operations.

title: Assistant Manager - Machine Shop Production
description:
**Company Description**
Inled Technologies LLP is a diversified manufacturing company operating across LED lighting, high pressure die-casting, and gear cutting tools, with each division managed as an independent cost center. The Lighting Division, certified to ISO 9001:2015, specializes in LED light manufacturing and has supplied over 225,000 street lights in Goa using state-of-the-art facilities and an in-house testing lab. The High Pressure Die Casting division, IATF certified, offers end-to-end component solutions with comprehensive in-house processes and serves clients in Germany and India while expanding its global presence. The Gear Cutting Tool division, also ISO 9001:2015 certified, exports to over 45 countries and manufactures precision tools with accuracy up to 0.001 microns. Inled has additionally invested in drone manufacturing through Ikran Aerospace and Technologies Pvt. Ltd., strengthening its role in advanced engineering for the aeronautical industry.
  
**Role Description**
The Assistant Manager – Machine Shop Production will oversee day-to-day production operations in the machine shop, ensuring delivery targets, quality standards, and safety requirements are consistently met. Responsibilities include planning and scheduling machining activities, allocating resources, monitoring workflow, and coordinating with maintenance and quality teams to minimize downtime. The role requires supervising and guiding shop-floor personnel, resolving production issues, implementing process improvements, and maintaining accurate production records and reports. The Assistant Manager will collaborate with senior management on continuous improvement initiatives, cost optimization, and adherence to company standards and customer specifications. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Khandala.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong production planning and production management skills, with experience in scheduling, resource allocation, and meeting output targets.
* Hands-on expertise in machining processes, machine shop operations, and tooling relevant to high-precision manufacturing.
* Knowledge of quality management, including quality systems, process control, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Proficiency in inspection techniques, use of measuring instruments, and interpretation of engineering drawings and tolerances.
* Diploma or degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Experience in machine shop or manufacturing environments, ideally within automotive, tooling, or metal components industries.
* Ability to lead teams, communicate clearly, and collaborate with cross-functional departments.
* Familiarity with safety standards, 5S, lean manufacturing concepts, and basic computer skills for production reporting.

title: Senior Maintenance Engineer - Plant Maintenance (Heavy Engineering & Fabrication)
description:
**About Zeeco**
Zeeco is a global leader in advanced combustion and environmental solutions, providing innovative products and services to the oil & gas, petrochemical, refining, power, and process industries. With manufacturing and engineering operations across the globe, Zeeco offers an opportunity to work on world-class industrial equipment while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced
**Plant Maintenance professional**
to lead maintenance operations at our heavy fabrication manufacturing facility. This role is ideal for candidates passionate about equipment reliability, preventive maintenance, team leadership, and improving plant performance.
  
  
**Experience:**
10 to 12 years of experience
  
  
**Qualification**

* Diploma / B.E. in Mechanical Engineering
* Additional certifications in Maintenance Management, TPM, Reliability Engineering, or Safety will be an added advantage.
* Proven hands-on experience with fabrication plant machinery, including welding/cutting setups, hydraulics, pneumatics, and cranes. Skilled in both mechanical and electrical preventive maintenance.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Maintenance Operations:**

* Plan, organize, and supervise preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance activities to ensure uninterrupted production.
* Maximize machine availability while minimizing equipment downtime and maintenance costs.
* Prioritize maintenance activities based on production requirements and equipment criticality.
* Lead daily maintenance planning meetings and ensure timely execution of maintenance schedules.
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring equipment failures and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.

**Preventive & Predictive Maintenance**

* Develop, implement, and continuously improve Preventive Maintenance (PM) schedules for all critical manufacturing equipment.
* Monitor PM compliance and identify opportunities to improve equipment reliability.
* Establish equipment maintenance history and reliability improvement programs.

**Equipment & Utilities Maintenance**
Lead maintenance activities for:
  
  

* Welding and cutting machines
* Hydraulic and pneumatic systems
* Gearboxes, motors, pumps, compressors, and blowers
* EOT cranes and material handling equipment
* Fabrication machinery and production equipment
* Industrial utilities and supporting infrastructure
* Electrical systems associated with plant machinery

**Reliability & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive TPM, 5S, Kaizen, and Lean Maintenance initiatives across the plant.
* Improve equipment reliability through predictive maintenance and condition monitoring.
* Identify opportunities to reduce downtime, maintenance costs, and energy consumption.
* Recommend and implement equipment modifications to improve productivity and operational efficiency.

**Planning & Coordination**

* Coordinate closely with Production, Quality, Purchase, Stores, Projects, and Engineering teams.
* Plan shutdown maintenance and annual maintenance activities.
* Ensure availability of critical spare parts, maintenance consumables, and specialized tools.
* Coordinate with external vendors for AMC, inspections, repairs, calibration, and servicing.

**Projects & Plant Expansion**

* Support installation, commissioning, relocation, and modification of machinery and utilities.
* Participate in plant expansion, automation, and capacity enhancement projects.
* Provide technical support during equipment procurement and commissioning.

**Cost & Budget Management**

* Prepare and manage annual maintenance budgets.
* Monitor maintenance expenditure and optimize maintenance costs without compromising reliability.
* Manage CAPEX proposals related to equipment upgrades and new machinery.

**Documentation & Compliance**

* Maintain maintenance records, equipment history, SOPs, PM checklists, drawings, manuals, and calibration records.
* Ensure compliance with statutory regulations, company standards, LOTO procedures, and safety requirements.
* Drive timely closure of internal and external audit observations.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Machine Availability ≥ 95%
* Reduction in equipment breakdown hours
* Improvement in Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF)
* Reduction in Mean Time To Repair (MTTR)
* Preventive Maintenance Compliance
* Maintenance Cost Optimization
* Critical Spare Parts Availability
* Reduction in Repeat Equipment Failures
* Energy Efficiency Improvement
* Safety Compliance and Zero Lost Time Incidents

**Technical Competencies**
The ideal candidate should possess strong hands-on knowledge of:
  
  

* Preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance
* Mechanical and electrical maintenance practices
* Hydraulic and pneumatic systems
* Welding and cutting machinery
* Gearboxes, motors, pumps, compressors, and rotating equipment
* EOT cranes and material handling systems
* Fabrication machinery maintenance
* Maintenance planning and scheduling
* Spare parts planning and inventory management
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* TPM, 5S, Kaizen, and Lean Manufacturing
* Machine installation and commissioning
* Equipment reliability and condition monitoring

**Preferred Industry Background**

* Heavy Engineering
* Pressure Vessel Manufacturing
* Process Equipment Manufacturing
* Oil & Gas Equipment
* Boiler Manufacturing
* Industrial Burners & Combustion Systems
* Steel & Metal Fabrication
* EPC Manufacturing
* Process Plants
* Industrial Machinery Manufacturing

title: Assistant Manager – Inventory & Flow Planning
description:
Fruit Formulations (FruitFM) is hiring an Assistant Manager – Inventory & Flow Planning for our Jejuri plant. You'll own one clear daily plan for materials, production and dispatch, and keep one correct view of demand, stock and QA status, so the factory avoids shortages, excess, ageing and expiry while protecting delivery, food safety and cash.

What you'll do

- Prepare the daily plan for approved demand, materials, production and dispatch

- Keep stock correct by item, batch, location, expiry and QA status; match physical stock with ERP

- Flag shortages, excess, near-expiry stock and blocked WIP early; close actions with Sales, Procurement, Stores, Production, QA and Finance

- Run a short daily flow meeting and weekly stock review; follow FEFO and batch traceability; escalate risks within 2 hours

What we're looking for

- Bachelor's in supply chain, engineering, operations, food technology or related field

- 4–7 years' experience, including 2+ years in manufacturing inventory or planning (food, beverage, FMCG or batch manufacturing preferred)

- Strong ERP and Excel; working knowledge of MRP, BOM, FEFO and stock control

- Practical, hands-on, comfortable on the factory floor

Reports to Head – Factory Operations.

title: Production Engineer - Heavy Engineering Fabrication
description:
**About Zeeco**
Zeeco is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of advanced combustion and environmental solutions serving the refining, petrochemical, oil & gas, power, chemical, and pharmaceutical industries. Headquartered in the United States, Zeeco designs and manufactures world-class burners, flares, thermal oxidizers, vapor recovery systems, and fired equipment that help customers improve process efficiency while reducing emissions.
  
  
With manufacturing and engineering facilities across the globe, Zeeco combines innovative technology, engineering excellence, and superior manufacturing capabilities to deliver customized solutions that meet the highest international quality standards.
  
  
**Position Overview**
Zeeco India is seeking an experienced
**Production Engineer**
to lead and coordinate the fabrication and manufacturing of heavy process equipment including
**pressure vessels, process skids, columns, ducting, stacks, structural assemblies, and other static equipment**
.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess
**8 to 12 years of hands-on shop floor experience**
in heavy engineering fabrication and should have a strong understanding of fabrication methodologies, welding processes, production planning, resource optimization, quality requirements, and statutory fabrication codes. The individual will be responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and timely execution of manufacturing activities while maintaining the highest standards of quality and productivity.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
****Production Planning & Manufacturing Execution:****

* Plan, schedule, and monitor fabrication activities to achieve project delivery milestones.
* Prepare daily and weekly production plans based on project priorities and manufacturing capacity.
* Coordinate fabrication activities involving pressure vessels, process skids, structural assemblies, ducting, stacks, and other static equipment.
* Review engineering drawings, fabrication drawings, General Arrangement (GA) drawings, Bill of Materials (BOM), welding maps, and manufacturing specifications before production.
* Ensure optimum utilization of manpower, machinery, consumables, and shop floor resources.
* Monitor production progress and proactively resolve manufacturing bottlenecks to achieve committed delivery schedules.
* Coordinate closely with Engineering, Planning, Procurement, QA/QC, and Project Management teams throughout the manufacturing cycle.

****Heavy Fabrication & Shop Floor Management:****
  
  

* Supervise fabrication activities including:

+ Plate cutting
+ Rolling
+ Forming
+ Fit-up
+ Welding
+ Assembly
+ Structural fabrication
+ Equipment integration
+ Final assembly

* Ensure fabrication activities comply with approved fabrication procedures and project requirements.
* Monitor welding activities and ensure compliance with approved WPS, PQR, and welder qualifications.
* Oversee fabrication of Carbon Steel, Stainless Steel, Duplex Stainless Steel, Alloy Steel, and other process equipment materials.
* Ensure dimensional accuracy through regular inspections during fabrication and assembly.
* Coordinate lifting, handling, and movement of heavy fabricated components within the workshop.

****Quality, Codes & Compliance:****
  
  

* Ensure manufacturing activities comply with applicable international standards including:

+ ASME Section VIII Div.1
+ ASME Section IX
+ API Standards
+ ISO Standards
+ Customer Specifications

* Coordinate with QA/QC during:

+ Fit-up inspections
+ Welding inspections
+ Visual inspection
+ NDT activities
+ Hydrostatic testing
+ Pneumatic testing
+ Dimensional inspection
+ Final release inspections

* Maintain complete fabrication documentation, weld traceability, material traceability, and production records.
* Support customer inspections, third-party inspections, and statutory audits.

****People Management & Shop Floor Leadership:****

* Lead welders, fitters, fabricators, riggers, and technicians.
* Allocate work based on manpower capability and production priorities.
* Monitor productivity and implement corrective actions where required.
* Mentor junior engineers and supervisors on fabrication best practices.
* Foster a culture of teamwork, accountability, quality, and operational excellence.

****Safety & Continuous Improvement:****

* Ensure strict adherence to company HSE policies and safe fabrication practices.
* Conduct regular shop floor inspections to eliminate unsafe conditions.
* Identify opportunities for improving productivity, reducing fabrication cycle time, and minimizing rework.
* Support implementation of Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) for quality issues and implement preventive actions.

**Mandatory Experience**
Candidates
**must have hands-on experience**
in the fabrication and manufacturing of one or more of the following:
  
  

* Pressure Vessels
* Process Skids
* Heat Exchangers
* Columns
* Reactors
* Storage Tanks
* Static Equipment
* Fired Heaters
* Thermal Oxidizers
* Process Equipment
* Heavy Structural Fabrication

**Experience From Industries Such As**

* Oil & Gas
* Petrochemical
* EPC
* Heavy Engineering
* Process Equipment Manufacturing
* Boiler Manufacturing
* Pressure Vessel Manufacturing
* Industrial Equipment Manufacturing

will be highly preferred.
  
  
**Technical Skills**

* Excellent understanding of heavy fabrication processes.
* Strong knowledge of welding processes (SMAW, GTAW, GMAW, SAW, FCAW).
* Knowledge of fabrication sequence planning.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings and fabrication documents.
* Knowledge of welding symbols, GD&T, tolerances, and dimensional control.
* Familiarity with WPS, PQR, WPQ, and welding documentation.
* Working knowledge of NDT methods and inspection requirements.
* Exposure to ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or equivalent.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

**Key Competencies**

* Heavy fabrication planning and execution
* Shop floor production management
* Resource planning and optimization
* Pressure vessel manufacturing
* Welding and fabrication supervision
* Manufacturing quality assurance
* Cross-functional coordination
* Production scheduling
* Problem-solving and decision-making
* Team leadership and people management
* Continuous improvement mindset
* Strong commitment to safety and quality

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Production Engineering.
* 8–12 years of relevant manufacturing experience in heavy engineering fabrication is preferred.

title: Construction Site Manager
description:
We are building two villa projects in Karjat - Trulife at Tadwadi and Goodlife at Kothimbe. We are looking for one person to run both sites: living at site, with real authority over execution, reporting directly to the founder.

**The work**

* Run day-to-day construction at both sites - manpower, material, sequence, quality, closure.
* Lead 10 to 15 engineers and supervisors, and 100 to 150+ workers across multiple contractors.
* Plan the week before it starts. Schedule, material indents, manpower, contractor commitments - fixed in advance, not decided on the morning.
* Send daily and weekly MIS to our head office in Vashi: progress against plan, manpower on site, material position, what is blocked.
* Hold quality. Check the work, and make it redone when it is not right.
* Meet customers who come to site. Villa buyers want to speak to someone senior and want a straight answer on their handover date. You will be that person.
* Keep contractors moving. Settle problems at site rather than escalating all of them.

**What we are looking for**

* 12 to 18 years on construction sites, with at least the last 5 running a project independently.
* Proven team size: 10+ engineers and supervisors, 100+ workers on site at peak.
* Experience at sites in Maharashtra.
* Diploma or degree in civil engineering.
* Fluent Hindi and Marathi. Able to hold a proper conversation with a customer in English.
* Someone who plans ahead rather than firefights, and who gets work finished on a date.

**What we provide**

* Stay and food at site.
* Rs 70,000 to Rs 1,20,000 per month, depending on what you have actually run.
* A direct line to the founder, and the authority to run the site your way.

**Being straight with you**

This is six days a week, long days, and you will live at site through the week, away from home. The sites are in Karjat, not in a city. If that does not suit you, this is not your job. If you have done it before and you enjoy running a site properly - planned, clean, on date - you will like it here.

**How to apply**

Apply here on LinkedIn. If we shortlist you, we will send you a short set of questions to answer in writing, then an online interview, then a visit to the site to meet us and walk the project.

title: Section Manager Quality
description:

title: Chief Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Job Summary
  
  
The Chief Engineer will be responsible for overseeing all engineering, maintenance, utilities, and technical operations of the resort, ensuring uninterrupted functioning of facilities, guest rooms, restaurants, and adventure activities while maintaining safety and operational efficiency.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Oversee the maintenance and operation of electrical, mechanical, plumbing, HVAC, and civil systems.
  
  
Ensure preventive and corrective maintenance of all resort facilities and equipment.
  
  
Manage DG sets, transformers, chillers, boilers, STP, WTP, swimming pools, and other utilities.
  
  
Ensure uninterrupted power, water supply, air-conditioning, and other essential services.
  
  
Develop and implement preventive maintenance schedules and engineering SOPs.
  
  
Monitor energy consumption and implement cost-saving and energy-efficiency initiatives.

title: Lead Construction Manager
description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
 The Lead Construction Manager is responsible for leading and overseeing all construction activities related to civil, structural, and mechanical disciplines during project execution. The role ensures safe, high\-quality, and efficient delivery of construction works while achieving project objectives related to scope, schedule, cost, quality, and compliance. The position serves as the primary site leader coordinating contractors, engineers, suppliers, and stakeholders throughout construction, commissioning support, and project handover.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Construction Leadership \& Site Management**
* Lead all site construction activities across civil, structural, mechanical, piping, and utility scopes.
* Establish execution strategies, construction methodologies, and resource plans.
* Direct field teams and contractors to ensure efficient execution of work packages.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for site construction performance.


**Civil \& Structural Construction Management**
* Oversee earthworks, excavation, foundations, piling, concrete structures, buildings, roads, drainage systems, and underground utilities.
* Ensure construction activities are executed according to approved designs, specifications, and engineering standards.
* Coordinate interfaces between civil works and mechanical installation activities.


**Mechanical Construction Management**
* Lead installation of process equipment, utilities, piping systems, HVAC, tanks, pumps, and supporting infrastructure.
* Ensure proper sequencing of equipment erection, alignment, testing, and mechanical completion.
* Support commissioning and start\-up readiness activities.
* Resolve field technical issues in collaboration with engineering teams and vendors.


**Contractor \& Stakeholder Management**
* Manage EPC/EPCM contractors, subcontractors, consultants, and suppliers.
* Conduct contractor performance reviews and monitor productivity.
* Lead construction progress meetings and coordinate stakeholder alignment.
* Ensure effective communication between project management, engineering, operations, maintenance, and safety teams.


**Safety, Health \& Environmental Management**
* Promote and enforce a zero\-accident safety culture.
* Ensure compliance with site safety requirements, permit\-to\-work systems, and regulatory standards.
* Lead risk assessments, toolbox talks, incident investigations, and corrective actions.
* Drive EHS compliance throughout project execution.


**Schedule, Cost \& Risk Management**
* Monitor construction schedules, milestones, and productivity metrics.
* Identify critical path risks and develop recovery plans when required.
* Control construction budgets and manage variations, claims, and change orders.
* Support forecasting and reporting to project leadership.


**Quality Assurance \& Compliance**
* Ensure implementation of QA/QC processes, inspection plans, and testing requirements.
* Review and approve method statements, inspection records, and construction documentation.
* Drive first\-time\-right execution and minimize rework.
* Ensure statutory, regulatory, and company compliance requirements are met.


**Commissioning \& Handover**
* Coordinate mechanical completion and turnover processes.
* Ensure punch\-list closure and construction readiness for commissioning.
* Support operational acceptance, training, and project handover.
* Ensure as\-built documentation and final project records are complete.


**In this role you’ll make an impact by:**
* Delivering complex construction projects safely, on time, and within budget while maintaining the highest standards of quality and compliance.
* Leading multidisciplinary civil and mechanical construction teams to achieve key project milestones and operational readiness.
* Driving construction excellence through proactive planning, contractor management, and risk mitigation.
* Ensuring seamless integration between civil infrastructure, mechanical systems, utilities, equipment installation, and commissioning activities.
* Creating a strong safety culture that prioritizes people, environmental sustainability, and operational integrity.
* Enabling successful project handover through disciplined execution, quality assurance, and stakeholder collaboration.


**To succeed:**
**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline.
* Professional certification in Project Management, Construction Management, or equivalent preferred.


**Experience**
* 15\+ years of experience in industrial construction, manufacturing projects, CAPEX projects, chemical/manufacturing industries.
* Proven experience managing both civil and mechanical construction activities.
* Experience in greenfield and brownfield project execution.
* Strong experience in contractor construction management and commissioning support.


**Key Competencies**
* Construction Execution Leadership
* Civil \& Structural Engineering Knowledge
* Mechanical Installation Management
* Contractor Management
* Project Planning \& Scheduling
* Cost and Risk Management
* EHS Leadership
* Quality Management
* Stakeholder Management
* Conflict Resolution and Decision Making
